CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cpa_claim_grading_run(p_attempt_id uuid, p_owner_user_id uuid, p_metadata jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform public.common_assert_cpa_attempt(p_attempt_id,p_owner_user_id);
  return public.common_legacy_cpa_claim_grading_run(p_attempt_id,p_owner_user_id,p_metadata);
end $function$
